verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automation feature that runs autonomously in the background. Webhooks are a developer building block for building downstream logic, not an automation capability of the product itself. Gusto's managed compliance services, such as mail monitoring and deadline alerts, are operations Gusto runs for you, not automations a user sets up.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
